description: This file defines the ConferencingService class, which manages conferencing app integrations, including connecting, disconnecting, setting defaults, and generating OAuth URLs for various conferencing platforms like Google Meet, Zoom, and Office365.

classes.name: ConferencingService
classes.description: Service class for managing conferencing app integrations, including connecting, disconnecting, setting defaults, and OAuth URL generation.

methods.name: getConferencingApps
methods.description: Retrieves conferencing applications associated with a user.

methods.name: connectUserNonOauthApp
methods.description: Connects a non-OAuth conferencing app (e.g., Google Meet) to a user.

methods.name: connectOauthApps
methods.description: Handles OAuth connection flow for conferencing apps like Zoom and Office365.

methods.name: getUserDefaultConferencingApp
methods.description: Fetches the default conferencing app for a user.

methods.name: checkAppIsValidAndConnected
methods.description: Validates if a conferencing app is connected for a user.

methods.name: disconnectConferencingApp
methods.description: Disconnects a conferencing app from a user.

methods.name: setDefaultConferencingApp
methods.description: Sets a user's default conferencing app.

methods.name: generateOAuthUrl
methods.description: Generates OAuth authorization URL for a specified conferencing app.
